answer_1.quote: The datasets we use in the experiments are HANNA, OpenMEVA-MANS, SummEval, LLMBar, MT-Bench, and LLMEval2, covering tasks of story generation (HANNA, OpenMEVA-MANS), summarization (SummEval), and instruction following (the other three).
answer_1.outputs: text outputs generated by language models

answer_2.quote: common automatic approaches to evaluating quality of AI-generated text include heuristic-based evaluation metrics, model-based evaluation metrics, and recently, LLM-based evaluations

answer_3.quote: We employ GPT-3.5-turbo-0125 (OpenAI, 2023) and Gemini-1.0-Pro as the evaluator models for our experiments.

answer_4.quote: All of them provide machine-generated content with human annotations.
answer_4.guideline: H(y0, y1) = 0 indicates that the output y0 is preferred over y1 by an average human expert, and H(y0, y1) = 1 indicates the opposite.
